# Courier Logistics Dispatch Label Template

## Courier & Logistics Parcel Label Template

Designed for domestic and international courier packages.

### Production Template
```html
<div class="shipping-label" style="width: 99.1mm; height: 139mm; border: 1px solid #000; padding: 4mm; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: sans-serif;">
  <div style="border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 2mm; display: flex; justify-content: space-between;">
    <div><strong>EXPRESS COURIER</strong></div>
    <div>AWB: <strong>NP-98210349</strong></div>
  </div>
  <div style="margin-top: 3mm;">
    <div style="font-size: 8pt; color: #666;">SHIP TO:</div>
    <div style="font-size: 12pt; font-weight: bold;">Ram Bahadur Thapa</div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">Ward No. 4, New Road</div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">Pokhara, Kaski, Nepal</div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">TEL: +977 9801234567</div>
  </div>
  <div style="margin-top: 5mm; text-align: center;">
    <svg id="barcode-awb" style="width: 80mm; height: 25mm;"></svg>
  </div>
</div>
```
Recommended SKU: **ST-4 A4100** (4 labels/sheet).
